products.name: deploy-arch-ibm-ocp-vpc
products.label: Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform on VPC
products.short_description: Deploy a Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform cluster on IBM Cloud VPC infrastructure with integrated security and observability.
products.long_description:
This deployable architecture provides a comprehensive solution for deploying Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform (OCP) clusters on IBM Cloud Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) infrastructure. It includes two variations: a QuickStart option for rapid deployment and development, and a fully-configurable option for production workloads with advanced security, encryption, and compliance features.

The solution automates the provisioning of:
- Red Hat OpenShift clusters with customizable worker pools
- VPC networking with subnets and security groups
- IBM Cloud Object Storage for registry backup
- Optional KMS encryption for cluster and boot volumes
- Optional Secrets Manager integration for certificate management
- Optional audit logging capabilities
- Context-based restrictions for enhanced security
